Detects debris in every photo, video and continuous scan.
Detailed analysis, reports with tools and species identification.
Gemma 4 trained on marine debris. Detects, writes reports and identifies species.
Needed to identify species. Without it BioDex only knows four sample species.

Detection: RT-DETRv2 (TensorFlow Lite) and Gemma 4 (LiteRT-LM). Reports: Gemma 4 (LiteRT-LM), or Qwen and GGUF (llama.cpp).
Model family that writes reports. Gemma 4 uses tools in two phases; Qwen and GGUF use a simpler method.
The GGUF only writes reports. It does not change detection.
